name: See Tình
blurb: Hoàng Thùy Linh's 2022 V-pop hit, the "ding ding dang dang" song of Douyin and TikTok
title: See Tình by Hoàng Thùy Linh: The "Ting Ting Tang Tang" TikTok Song
description: See Tình is a 2022 song by Vietnamese singer Hoàng Thùy Linh. Its chorus made it the "ting ting tang tang" dance hit on TikTok and "叮叮当当" on Douyin.
h1: What is the "ting ting tang tang" song?
answer: The "ting ting tang tang" song is "See Tình" by Vietnamese singer Hoàng Thùy Linh, released on 20 February 2022 on her album Link. A sped-up Cukak remix took off on short-video apps: in China it became the Douyin hit nicknamed "叮叮当当" (ding ding dang dang) in summer 2022, and in late 2022 it became a TikTok dance craze, especially in the Philippines. The title is a pun on "si tình", Vietnamese for "lovesick".

body: People dance a short, cheerful routine to the chorus, whose "tình tình tang tang" syllables sound like a bell to non-Vietnamese ears. That is where the nicknames come from: "ting ting tang tang" in the Philippines and "叮叮当当" in China. The moves are simple arm and hand gestures with a little bounce, so everyone from a Filipino priest to athletes and K-pop idols joined in.

body.note: Most viral clips use the Cukak Remix (released 5 May 2022) or its sped-up version, not the original, softer album track.

head: Date
Event
rows: Hoàng Thùy Linh presents the song and music video in Ho Chi Minh City; it is released digitally the next day.
Cukak's remix (5 May) and a sped-up version (6 May) come out.
A "叮叮当当" dance set to the song sparks a cover-dance wave on Chinese short-video apps; by mid-August the Douyin topic has over 600 million views.
The "ting ting tang tang" dance becomes one of the most-copied TikTok challenges in the Philippines.
Jolin Tsai dances to it over the Lunar New Year, and Mango TV's Riding the Wind 2023 performs it under the title "Ding Ding Dang Dang".

body: "See tình" is a playful spelling of "si tình", which means lovesick or madly in love; and the English "see" fits the song's love-at-first-sight theme. The song is a sweet love song, and the bell-like hook is just sung syllables, not words with a fixed meaning.

ul: No. 2 on Billboard's Vietnam Hot 100 and No. 1 on Top Vietnamese Songs; No. 6 on the 2022 Vietnam Hot 100 year-end chart.
Song of the Year at the 2022 Green Wave Awards, and Best Music Video at the 2023 Dedication Music Awards.
Chinese reports cited more than 3.6 billion views for related dance topics on one platform, and about 350,000 TikTok videos used the sound.

faq.a: Vietnamese singer Hoàng Thùy Linh (黄垂玲 in Chinese). The song was written and produced by the Vietnamese production group DTAP.

faq.q: How does the "ting ting tang tang" dance go?
faq.a: It is a light, bouncy routine on the chorus: simple arm swings and hand gestures in time with the bell-like syllables, easy enough to learn from one clip. Most people dance it to the faster Cukak remix.

faq.q: What is the song called in Chinese?
faq.a: Chinese users mostly call it "叮叮当当" after the chorus. Chinese media also give the title as 《见爱响铃》.
